name: Multi-Monitor Workspaces
author: David Boulay
description: Multi-monitor: each monitor gets its own isolated set of workspaces 1-9

barWidget.description: Workspace numbers for this screen only

schema.label: Workspaces per screen
schema.description: How many numbered workspaces each screen gets, 1 to 10 (10 is the 0 key). SUPER + a number past this is unbound instead of jumping to another screen.

schema.label: Per-screen navigation keys
schema.description: Makes SUPER+TAB / SUPER+SHIFT+TAB cycle this screen's workspaces, SUPER+CTRL+TAB return to this screen's previous one, and SUPER+SHIFT+ALT+arrow send this workspace's windows to the screen in that direction. A key you bound yourself in ~/.config/hypr is always left alone.

schema.label: Chinese workspace numbers
schema.description: Display workspace slots 1–10 as 一 through 十. Keyboard shortcuts stay the same.
